svg.title: Drugs in rheumatology as a decision: steroids and NSAIDs relieve symptoms fast but do not stop joint damage; conventional DMARDs and then biologics modify the disease. Mnemonics: GLAM for high-dose prednisone, DORC for the relative contraindications to steroids, CUSHINGOID for chronic steroid side effects, GHMI for the shared DMARD toxicities
